Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/silverfox-2096/private-browser/security/advisories/new) for sensitive security reports. Do not include secrets or private captures.

## Outcome

What specific result should this task deliver?

## Scope and completion evidence

Describe the bounded work and the evidence needed to finish it. Keep untested coverage explicit.

## Operational requirements

For live interruptions, follow FOLLOW-UP-PLAN.md: fresh browser-closure confirmation, updater lock, maintenance gate, viewer checks, rollback and verified recovery. Host-boot experiments require separate authorization.
